title: Q-TEMPORAL-e5ddf8e610: repeated failure: ledger:executor:pr-outcome
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation temporal --settled e5ddf8e610
**Status:** closed

Temporal loop finding (repeated_failure) in foundation: pr-outcome: 1 failures in a row, 5 in the last 3 days against 0 in the 8 before. Seen in 1 runs since 2026-11-21T11:56:24Z. Advocate: operations.

Find the root cause of the repeated failure, not the symptom. `python3 -m foundation pathfinder --regress` lists the commits since it last worked; fix, add a regression test, and let the ledger show a pass.

Files: foundation/executor.py.

Prediction: ledger:executor:pr-outcome has no failure in its next 3 events within 7 days.

This item closes when the finding no longer holds (`python3 -m foundation temporal --settled e5ddf8e610` recomputes it from the repository's own history).

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation temporal --settled e5ddf8e610.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:21:05Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-25T02:11:40Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: no longer detected
